channel.title: CERT@VDE — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by CERT@VDE (certvde).

item.title: CVE-2025-41725 · 6.5 MEDIUM — DoS vulnerability in JBL Flip 4
item.description: Affected devices running firmware versions prior to 4.1.0 may crash and become unavailable when receiving specific malformed Bluetooth messages from an unauthenticated attacker.

item.title: CVE-2026-40820 · 6.9 MEDIUM — Authenticated SQLi in getVpnData function
item.description: A high privileged remote attacker can exploit an unauthenticated SQL Injection vulnerability in the getVpnData function due to improper neutralization of special elements in a SQL SELECT command. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality.

item.title: CVE-2026-18769 · 8.5 HIGH — Insufficient IOCTL access control allows local relocation of arbitrary physical memory
item.description: A local low privileged attacker can move arbitrary physical memory content via TcRouter.sys because of exposed IOCTL function calls resulting in a full compromise of the affected devices.

item.title: CVE-2026-18768 · 8.5 HIGH — Insufficient IOCTL access control allows local access to arbitrary physical memory
item.description: A local low privileged attacker can access arbitrary physical memory or define its mapping via TcRouter.sys because of exposed IOCTL function calls resulting in a full compromise of the affected devices.

item.title: CVE-2026-18767 · 8.5 HIGH — Insufficient IOCTL access control allows local access to I/O ports
item.description: A local low privileged attacker or process can access I/O ports via TcRouter.sys because of exposed IOCTL function calls resulting in a full compromise of the affected devices.

item.title: CVE-2026-60046 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — DoS via password reset
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can perform password resets for any user with known username and email without rate limiting. This can result in a total loss of availabilit since the password will be reseted.

item.title: CVE-2026-60045 · 6.9 MEDIUM — Arbitrary file upload
item.description: A high privileged remote attacker can upload arbitrary files to a guessable location. This can result in a loss of availability and might be chained with other vulnerabilities.

item.title: CVE-2026-60044 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — Static backup password
item.description: The backups created by the application use a weak static password allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to access their content. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality.

item.title: CVE-2026-60043 · 9.3 CRITICAL 🌩️ — XSS in backend
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can perform a XSS attack on a logged in backend user allowing for execution of multiple critical system actions. This could allow an attacker to shutdown the server or restore an uploaded backup. This can result in…

item.title: CVE-2026-60042 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Authentication bypass in com_check
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can perform an authentication bypass on the com_check function, potentially triggering traffic on other systems and email alerts. This can result in some loss of availability due to higher system loads.

item.title: CVE-2026-60041 · 8.1 HIGH 🌩️ — CSRF in backend
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can perform a CSRF attack on a logged in backend user allowing for execution of multiple critical system actions. This could allow an attacker to shutdown the server or restore an uploaded backup. This can result in…

item.title: CVE-2026-60040 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — DoS in backup creation
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can perform a DoS in the backends backup creation function. This can result in a total loss of availability.

item.title: CVE-2026-60039 · 8.6 HIGH — Command injection in backup restore
item.description: A high privileged remote attacker can perform a code injection in the backends backup restore function leading to code execution. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability.

item.title: CVE-2026-60038 · 8.6 HIGH — OpenSSL command injection in ImportPKCS12
item.description: A high privileged remote attacker can perform an OpenSSL code injection in the backends ImportPKCS12 function leading to code execution. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability.

item.title: CVE-2026-60037 · 8.6 HIGH — OpenSSL command injection in device importer
item.description: A high privileged remote attacker can perform an OpenSSL code injection in the frontends device importer function leading to code execution. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability.

item.title: CVE-2026-60036 · 8.6 HIGH — Command injection in patch activate
item.description: A high privileged remote attacker can perform a code injection in the backends patch activate function leading to code execution. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability.

item.title: CVE-2026-60035 · 8.6 HIGH — Command injection in network auth
item.description: A high privileged remote attacker can perform a code injection in the backends network auth function leading to code execution. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability.

item.title: CVE-2026-110935 · 8.6 HIGH — Path traversal in plug-in deployment
item.description: The PFI plugin framework deployment routine does not validate path components when extracting archive entries to the local plugin repository. Archive entries containing relative path segments such as '..' are not rejected, allowing an unauthenticated…

item.title: CVE-2026-110022 · 8.6 HIGH — Signed plug-in validation bypass
item.description: The PFI plugin framework deploys executable assemblies (DLLs) from a signed plugin package into the local plugin repository and loads them via reflection, but the deployment routine processes archive entries that were never covered by the signature v…

item.title: CVE-2026-110021 · 6.9 MEDIUM — Missing GSDX SignatureValue verification
item.description: PLCnext Engineer checks GSDX manifest reference digests but does not cryptographically verify the XML `SignatureValue` over canonicalized `SignedInfo`. An unauthenticated local attacker can modify signed GSDML content, update its manifest digest, ret…

item.title: CVE-2026-109161 · 6.9 MEDIUM — Buffer Overflow in Digital I/O
item.description: Insufficient bounds checking in the Digital I/O function may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to cause a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-105982 · 8.6 HIGH — Command Injection in IPsec VPN
item.description: Improper input validation in the IPsec VPN function may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to inject system commands and execute them with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-105981 · 8.6 HIGH — Command Injection in Digital I/O
item.description: Improper input validation in the Digital I/O function may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to inject operating system commands and execute them with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-105980 · 8.6 HIGH — Command Injection in WireGuard VPN
item.description: Improper input validation in the WireGuard VPN function may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to inject system commands and execute them with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-105979 · 8.6 HIGH — Command Injection in ZeroTier VPN
item.description: Improper input validation in the ZeroTier VPN function may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to inject system commands and execute them with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-105978 · 8.6 HIGH — Command Injection in Management Control Functions
item.description: Improper input validation in management control functions may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to inject operating system commands and execute them with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-107564 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — gocsaf/csaf: csaf_provider prone to uncontrolled resource consumption
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker may use an allocation of resources without limits or throttling weakness in the affected product to cause high CPU load leading to a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-94410 · 5.3 MEDIUM — Exposure of Role List to Low-Privileged Remote Users in Bender Custom&Partner Service
item.description: A low privileged remote attacker is able to view a list of roles that should only be accessible to administrators. This results in a low level of confidentiality breach, as no particularly sensitive information is affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-94293 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Missing authentication for critical function in the aas-edge-client REST API
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can modify Asset Administration Shell submodel data via PATCH requests and can read all data exposed by the GET endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2025-41753 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Path traversal in dynamically created BACnet File Objects
item.description: The object name of a dynamically created BACnet File Object is interpreted as a file path without sufficient validation. Because relative paths are not limited to the intended directory, an unauthenticated remote attacker can traverse outside of it a…

item.title: CVE-2026-76992 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — Uncontrolled Memory Allocation in CODESYS Gateway Client
item.description: The CODESYS Gateway Client allocates memory based on a size field in a gateway response without enforcing an appropriate upper limit. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious gateway can exploit this behavior to trigger excessive me…

item.title: CVE-2026-79625 · 8.1 HIGH — Improper Synchronization in Monitoring in CODESYS Control Runtime
item.description: Affected products do not properly synchronize access to their monitoring functionality. When multiple clients send concurrent requests, this may lead to incorrect reads or writes, or to corruption of internal memory structures. An authenticated remot…

item.title: CVE-2026-27565 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Remote code execution via uploading a malicious IODD file
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can upload a malicious IODD file that places and executes a shell script with root privileges. The shell script remains active even after a reboot.

item.title: CVE-2026-27564 · 7.2 HIGH — Command Injection via PUT in /api/datastorage/data
item.description: A high-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /api/datastorage/data endpoint by sending a PUT request with admin credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27563 · 7.2 HIGH — Command Injection via GET in /api/datastorage/data
item.description: A high-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /api/datastorage/data endpoint by sending a crafted GET request with admin credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.description: A high-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /api/iodd/config endpoint by sending a crafted PUT request with admin credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27561 · 7.2 HIGH — Command Injection via GET in /api/iodd/config

item.description: A high-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /api/status/data endpoint by sending a crafted DELETE request with admin credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27559 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection via GET in /api/status/data
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /api/status/data endpoint by sending a crafted GET request with user credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27558 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection in /index.php/attached_devices_tab/ajax_remove_uploaded_iodd_files
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /index.php/attached_devices_tab/ajax_remove_uploaded_iodd_files endpoint using operator credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the devic…

item.title: CVE-2026-27557 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Path Traversal in /index.php/view_uploaded_iodd_file
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit a path traversal vulnerability in the /index.php/view_uploaded_iodd_file endpoint allowing the SSH server's private keys to be read.

item.title: CVE-2026-27556 · 8.8 HIGH — Local File Inclusion in /index.php/ajax/save_iodd_parameters
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a local file inclusion vulnerability in the /index.php/ajax/save_iodd_parameters endpoint using a valid operator cookie allowing execution of arbitrary PHP code on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27555 · 8.8 HIGH — Local File Inclusion in /index.php/ajax/get_iodd_port_info
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a local file inclusion vulnerability in the /index.php/ajax/get_iodd_port_info endpoint using a valid user cookie allowing execution of arbitrary PHP code on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27554 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection in /index.php/ajax/save_iodd_parameters
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /index.php/ajax/save_iodd_parameters endpoint using operator credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27553 · 6.5 MEDIUM — Information Disclosure via Schema Path Manipulation
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can manipulate the schema path parameter in the /index.php/diagnostics_tab/ajax_diag_table_rows endpoint using a valid user cookie allowing disclosure of all user password hashes.

item.title: CVE-2026-27552 · 8.1 HIGH — Unauthorized IODD File Upload due to Improper Authorization
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit improper authorization in the /index.php/attached_devices_tab/do_upload endpoint to upload IODD files to the device, potentially altering device behavior or causing system crashes.

item.title: CVE-2026-27551 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection in /index.php/ajax/parameterManage
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /index.php/ajax/parameterManage endpoint using user credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the Field_Shadow_Password class using operator credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27549 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection in /index.php/attached_devices_tab/do_upload
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /index.php/attached_devices_tab/do_upload endpoint using operator credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27548 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection in /index.php/ajax/get_iodd_port_info
